## Answer key: threshold evidence

Four percent of 2.50 V is 0.10 V, so the acceptable interval is 2.40 V through
2.60 V. A conformance claim additionally needs recorded measurements from the
built device, including the operating conditions, instrument range or
uncertainty, and enough repeated observations to support the stated scope.
:::
:::
